pages.text: The Akaishi Compressor $(4)presses dust and crystals into solid blocks$(0): loose powder in, neat blocks out. One slot in, one out — just feed it power. Each press takes 100 ticks at 15 energy/tick, with a 100k internal buffer.$(br2)$(bold)Key recipes:$(0)$(li)Coal / Iron / Copper / Gold / Lapis / Diamond / Emerald / Quartz Dust → 9 press into the matching block$(li)$(4)9 Netherite Dust → 1 Netherite Ingot$(0) (an ingot, not a block!)$(li)$(4)4 Obsidian Dust → 1 Obsidian$(0)$(li)9 Akaishi Dust → 1 Akaishi Essence$(li)9 Akaishi Crystals → 1 Akaishi Crystal Block$(br2)Note: the Akaishi Crystal Block is pressed here only — 9 crystals in a crafting table make a Raw Akaishi Block instead. Don't mix the two up.

Run your ores through the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) first, then press the dust here. The full dust list is in $(l:akaishi:dusts)Dusts$(/l), and crystal refining is covered in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).
